name: How long does an ADU feasibility consultation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does an ADU feasibility consultation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an ADU feasibility consultation can range from a quick phone discussion to a more in-depth site visit lasting several hours, depending on the complexity of your property and local regulations. A typical on-site consultation for a standard lot in cities like Dublin or Livermore might take 1-2 hours.
acceptedAnswer.description: The duration varies from a quick call to a multi-hour site visit, depending on property complexity and local regulations.
